items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, he had sung with Jimmy Noone in another big band in Chicago. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh. I didn't know that.

ctx.x: Yes. But, as I say, he made me remember -- and I had forgotten that he had worked at the -- you know -- he used to say -- "You know, I used to be an usher at the --". And, I remember seeing him after, you know, he told me that.
Well, he had sung with Jimmy Noone in another big band in Chicago.
